Cisco IOS-XE Quick Reference

This is a small HTML fixture used by the RAG extract tests. It must produce more than 100 characters of clean text once BeautifulSoup strips tags.

Show commands

  • show running-config — display the active configuration.
  • show ip interface brief — list interface state.
  • show ip bgp summary — display BGP neighbor summary.

Configuration

interface GigabitEthernet1
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
